subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use a, an, the or no article correctly.
Ask and answer questions about past holidays using the past simple.
Plan and write a short paragraph about my best moment.

tf.s: We use 'an' before a word that starts with a vowel sound, like 'an interesting blog'.
tf.why: 'Interesting' starts with a vowel sound, so we say 'an'.

tf.s: We say 'the communication is really important' when we talk about communication in general.
tf.why: Abstract nouns used in general take no article: 'Communication is really important'.

tf.s: 'Did you went to the beach?' is a correct question.
tf.why: After 'did' we use the base verb: 'Did you go to the beach?'

tf.s: We use 'a' before a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time.
tf.why: Yes, like 'I bought a new camera'.

tf.s: 'Writing a blog takes the time' is the correct sentence.
tf.why: 'Time' here is general and uncountable, so no article: 'takes time'.

tf.s: In the model paragraph, the writer played the piano at an audition.
tf.why: She played the violin at her audition.

tf.s: A good 'best moment' paragraph says why it was your best moment.
tf.why: Explaining why is one of the four questions in the task.

tf.s: A good paragraph about your best moment should use the present simple for the main events.
tf.why: The moment is in the past, so we use the past simple.

boxes.q: Complete: I bought ___ new camera last week.
boxes.why: 'New' starts with a consonant sound, and it's the first mention.
'Old' starts with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'.

boxes.q: What is the past simple of 'go'?

boxes.why: Did + base verb makes a past simple question.

boxes.q: What did speaker 2 think of the new food?
boxes.why: She didn't really like it because it was much too sweet.

boxes.q: Which photo matches the phrase 'Our new pet'?
boxes.why: Ryan's post about the new pet matches photo E.

boxes.q: Complete: I ___ (feel) nervous before the show.
About how long should your best moment paragraph be?
boxes.why: The task asks for a paragraph of about 100 words.

boxes.q: Which phrase can you use to give a reason?
Complete: ___ castle was near the sea. (We already know which castle.)
boxes.why: We use 'the' when the listener knows which thing we mean.

o: When it is clear which thing we mean
Before any word starting with a vowel
mcq.why: We use 'the' for something specific or already known.

mcq.q: Who has decided about their future job in the posts?
mcq.why: Dana says she now knows what kind of job she wants.

mcq.q: Which is the past simple of 'play'?
Which is NOT one of the four questions in the best moment task?
o: Why was it your best moment?
mcq.why: The four questions are when, what, which skills and why.
General abstract nouns take no article.

mcq.q: Correct the mistake: 'Did you swam outdoors?'
mcq.why: After 'did' we always use the base form.

mcq.q: Complete: Last summer we ___ to Salalah and ___ in the sea.
mcq.why: Both actions are finished in the past, so both verbs are past simple.

mcq.q: Why do we say 'an interesting blog' but 'a visitor'?
o: 'Interesting' starts with a vowel sound; 'visitor' starts with a consonant sound
'An' is for people, 'a' is for things
mcq.why: The choice between a and an depends on the first sound of the next word.

mcq.q: Why was the audition the writer's best moment?
o: She was accepted and learnt that hard work leads to success
She won a lot of money
mcq.why: Being accepted after hard practice made it special.

mcq.q: Your partner says, 'I didn't try any new food.' Which question did you probably ask?
o: Did you try a new food?
Do you try a new food?
Did you tried a new food?
Are you try a new food?
mcq.why: A past simple question uses Did + base verb.
